context: You are an assistant acting for Yadeesh T (yadeesh@kestrel.example), Engineering Manager of the Platform team at Kestrel Analytics. prompt: Using the Platform weekly sync notes from 21 Sep and 28 Sep, create a doc called 'Open Action Items — 7 Oct' that lists every action item still open as of the 28 Sep notes, grouped under a heading for each owner.
notes: An owner heading is a line holding the owner's name and at most two other words; each owner's items follow until the next heading. Closed items (canary plan, flaky tests, offsite dates) are absent everywhere. The capacity model moved from Karthik to Vikram.
